attacks.name: Trident
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
Before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Advance Toward the defender |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Armies of the Deep
steps: Each time this attack is chosen, this character may use one of the following effects:|\||~&*Swarm of Crabs&: Before &!damage& is dealt, the defender drops all Asset tokens it is holding.||~&*Octopus' Grasp&: Before &!damage& is dealt, other enemy characters within &!range& 2 of the defender suffer 1 &!damage& and are Pushed Away from the defender &!range_small&.||~&*Wave of Turtles&: After this attack is resolved, this character may immediately Interact with any number of objective tokens without spending &!power&. If it does, after all effects are resolved, this character may Advance &!range_small&.|

superPowers.name: IMPERIUS REX!
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes a move action followed by a |*Trident| attack. If this attack deals at least 1 |!damage|, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Atlantean Might
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.|\|Damage caused by this character's attacks and effects cannot be reduced or prevented by superpowers or Team Tactic Cards.

superPowers.name: Charismatic Leader
superPowers.body: This character and allied characters within |!range| 2 of it may reroll 1 die in their attack and defense rolls.
